GRADE 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify parts of a paragraph for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information.

2. About Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write a short coherent paragraph on the theme for self-expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information.

3. About Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify parts of a paragraph for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information.

5. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables.

6. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate vocabulary to construct sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables.

7. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables.

9. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. paraphrase trickster stories from their community for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories.

10. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse trickster stories from their community for understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories.

11. About Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. paraphrase trickster stories from their community for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories completely.
   C. Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Trickster stories.

13. About Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline key ideas and events in an animal story based on the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information.

14. About Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. compose an animal story featuring animal characters for self- expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information.

15. About Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. outline key ideas and events in an animal story based on the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information completely.
   C. Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Writing to give information.

17. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

18. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate vocabulary to construct sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

19. About Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills.

21. About Presentation Skills in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Presentation Skills using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Presentation Skills.

22. About Presentation Skills when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Presentation Skills at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Presentation Skills.

23. About Presentation Skills while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Presentation Skills helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Presentation Skills completely.
   C. Presentation Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Presentation Skills.

25. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. create a personal collection of vocabulary related to the theme for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information.

26. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. pick out emerging issues related to the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information.

27. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create a personal collection of vocabulary related to the theme for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information.

29. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the components of a letter of request for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request.

30. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a letter of request (for library or club membership) for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request.

31. About Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the components of a letter of request for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request completely.
   C. Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.3.1 Functional writing – Letter of request.
